about: Spoon densities for recipe-view hints next to small gram amounts. Applied into dictionary as entry.spoonGrams = { gPerTsp }. gPerTbsp is always 3 × gPerTsp (same volume). Thresholds and rounding live in the helper, not here.
sourceSnapshot: Box packs + PC dictionary (agar preferredUnit already g). Agar spoon rows still tsp/tbsp on box packs until agar-decisions apply; after that they are 4 g / 6 g.

agar-agar.note: Packed powder. Matches agar-decisions.json. Flakes are ~3× less potent by volume — not used here.

psyllium-husk.note: Matches house conversion used when grams → tbsp (1 tbsp = 8 g). Fibre husk powder.

flaxseed-ground.note: Ground flax meal ~7 g/tbsp (USDA / CompareSeeds). Whole flax is denser — see flaxseed-whole.

flaxseed-whole.note: USDA Seeds, flaxseed: 1 tbsp whole = 10.3 g.

chia-seeds.note: USDA chia: ~10.5 g/tbsp. Some converters list 12 g/tbsp; we use USDA.

carob-powder.note: Aligned with the 2 tbsp → 15 g conversion already applied. Branded Now Foods lists ~10 g/tbsp; powder packs differently.

dry-yeast.note: Standard baking: 1 tsp instant/dry yeast ≈ 3 g; an 11 g envelope ≈ 3.5 tsp.

miso-paste.note: USDA white miso ≈ 17 g/tbsp. Matches agar/unit decisions for miso.

nutritional-yeast.note: INGREDIENT_UNITS.md: nutritional yeast flakes 1 tbsp = 5 g. Preferred unit is already tbsp; hint only if a row is somehow in grams.

sunflower-seeds.note: Similar density to sesame; used as garnish in small gram amounts.

pumpkin-seeds.note: USDA pepitas ~10 g/tbsp. Only useful as a garnish hint under ~30 g.

potato-starch.note: App nutrition density for starches ~0.55 g/ml → ~8.3 g/tbsp.

cornstarch.note: Same starch density as potato starch. Preferred unit is already tbsp.

tapioca-starch.note: Same starch density. Preferred unit is already tbsp.

tahini.note: House density tahini 100 g/dl → 15 g/tbsp. Spoon-friendly paste.

peanut-butter.note: Typical smooth peanut butter ~16 g/tbsp. Sticky; hint still helps.

tomato-puree.note: House density tomato purée 105 g/dl → ~15.8 g/tbsp. Useful for the small 5–16 g rows.

date-paste.note: Thick paste; density varies with water content. Round numbers only.

cinnamon-ground.note: Matches unit-decisions conversion. Preferred unit is tsp; hint only if a row is in grams.

baking-powder.note: Common baking conversion ~4–5 g/tsp. Preferred unit already tsp.

baking-soda.note: Slightly denser than baking powder. Preferred unit already tsp.

salt.note: House salt ~1.2 g/ml → 6 g/tsp. Preferred unit tsp; rare leftover gram rows only.

herb-salt.note: Blend density varies by brand; slightly lighter than plain salt.

cayenne-pepper.note: Fine powder, a bit lighter than black pepper.

vanilla-powder.note: Varies by brand (with/without sugar). Prefer tsp rows.

ginger-fresh.note: Grated/minced ginger. A knob is ~30 g; spoon hints only for small grated amounts.

excluded: Flour, oats, polenta, breadcrumbs — weighed, not spooned at these sizes.
Vegetables, fruit, whole nuts, dates, olives, tofu, crispbread — counting/weighing is natural; a spoon hint is silly.
Oils, plant milks, water, juices — already volume.
Cocoa — not in the dictionary (carob covers the chocolate-like powder in this collection).
